WITH city_counts AS (
  SELECT c.location AS city, COUNT(*) AS qualifying_count
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN races r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
  JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  GROUP BY c.location
), city_shares AS (
  SELECT city, qualifying_count,
         1.0 * qualifying_count / SUM(qualifying_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM city_counts
)
SELECT city,
       qualifying_count,
       share,
       share - 1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER () AS above_average_share
FROM city_shares
WHERE share > 1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER ()
